enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off alarm. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn on tap. Wash face. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, taking a packed lunch from the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Take bread. Put bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait. Take toast out. Spread butter. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Open refrigerator. Take out packed lunch. Close refrigerator. Put lunch in bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in work uniform and checking personal phone for shift updates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work uniform. Take off sleepwear. Put on uniform pants. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Press power button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Scroll. Reply to message. Put phone in pocket. Check mirror. Adjust collar.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read news. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and updating clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Say 'Good morning.' Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Record notes on computer. Coordinate with nurse. Answer phone. Update clinical notes. Assist patient with walking. Change bandage. Sterilize equipment. Attend team meeting. Review lab results. Write reports.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Go to break room. Open locker. Take out lunch bag. Sit at table. Open lunch box. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Discard trash. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Attend to patient calls. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Check patient condition. Adjust bed position. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Coordinate with care team. Call doctor. Update patient records. Assist with patient transfer. Clean medical equipment. Attend training session. Consult with colleague. Review treatment plan. Write discharge summary.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cover. Simmer. Turn off induction cooker. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load utensils. Load cups. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Wipe table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Put phone down. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Go to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out. Dry body with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Wash face.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, browsing the phone and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Scroll. Watch video. Put phone down. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone again. Read article. Put phone down. Turn off TV. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to back. Stretch legs. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
